candidates.change_summary: Delete the statement `initialized=true;` so seedMarket never sets initialized to true.
Replace `initialized=true;` with `initialized=false;` so seedMarket sets initialized to false instead of true.
Delete the require statement so any caller can change ceoAddress to themselves.
Delete the assignment so ceoAddress never changes after deployment.
Invert the require check so that only a non-CEO caller can set ceoAddress.
Replace the assignment so ceoAddress is set to address(0) instead of msg.sender.
Replace the kilo computation so drugsUsed is divided by half of DRUGS_TO_PRODUCE_1KILO, doubling kilos produced.
Replace the additive Kilos update with a plain assignment to newKilo, discarding previously accumulated kilos.
Delete the statement that adds newly produced kilos to Kilos[msg.sender], so Kilos is never updated.
